name: Creamy Pasta
steps: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the milk and stir gently.
Add the cheese and continue stirring until the sauce becomes creamy and smooth.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the sauce and mix until all the pasta is coated.
Serve immediately while hot.
tips: Reserve a little pasta water in case the sauce becomes too thick.
Use freshly grated cheese for a smoother sauce.

name: Grilled Chicken
steps: Place the chicken breasts on a clean surface and gently flatten the thicker parts for even cooking.
Mix olive oil, lemon juice, minced garlic, parsley, black pepper, and salt in a bowl.
Coat the chicken with the mixture and let it rest for about 10 minutes.
Preheat a grill or grill pan over medium heat.
Place the chicken on the grill and cook until golden on one side.
Turn the chicken and continue cooking until completely cooked through.
Check that the thickest part of the chicken reaches a safe internal temperature of 74°C.
Remove from the heat and let the chicken rest for a few minutes before serving.
tips: Do not press the chicken repeatedly while grilling because it can lose moisture.
Letting the chicken rest before slicing helps keep it juicy.

name: Pancakes
steps: Melt one tablespoon of butter and let it cool slightly.
Mix the flour, sugar, salt, and baking powder in a bowl.
Add the milk, egg, and melted butter.
Whisk gently until the ingredients are combined. Do not overmix.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and lightly grease it with butter.
Pour a small amount of batter into the pan.
Cook until bubbles appear on the surface and the edges begin to set.
Flip the pancake and cook the other side until golden.
Repeat with the remaining batter.
Serve warm.
tips: Do not overmix the batter because this can make the pancakes dense.
Keep the heat at medium so the outside does not brown too quickly.

name: Beef Burger
steps: Divide the ground beef into two equal portions.
Shape each portion into a burger patty without pressing it too tightly.
Season both sides with salt and black pepper.
Heat a pan or grill over medium-high heat.
Cook the patties until browned on the first side.
Flip and continue cooking until the beef reaches a safe internal temperature of 71°C.
Place a cheese slice on each patty near the end of cooking and allow it to melt.
Lightly toast the burger buns.
Slice the tomato and onion.
Place the burger patty inside the bun and add the tomato and onion.
Serve immediately.
tips: Do not flatten the patty repeatedly while cooking.
Use a food thermometer to check that ground beef is safely cooked.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Cut the chicken into small pieces.
Heat the olive oil in a large pan or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until completely cooked through.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, peas, and garlic.
Stir-fry the vegetables for several minutes until slightly tender.
Push the chicken and vegetables to one side of the pan.
Crack the eggs into the empty side and scramble them until cooked.
Add the cooked rice to the pan.
Mix the rice, chicken, vegetables, and eggs together.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Stir-fry everything together for several minutes.
Serve hot.
tips: Cold cooked rice works especially well because it is less likely to become mushy.
Keep the pan hot while stir-frying.

name: Greek Salad
steps: Wash the vegetables thoroughly.
Cut the tomatoes into medium-sized pieces.
Slice the cucumber.
Thinly slice the onion.
Cut the cheese into cubes or crumble it.
Place the vegetables and cheese in a large bowl.
Add olive oil and lemon juice.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Gently toss everything together.
Serve immediately.
tips: Add the dressing shortly before serving to keep the vegetables fresh.
Cut the vegetables into similar-sized pieces for a better texture.

name: Chicken Sandwich
steps: Slice the chicken into thin pieces.
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the chicken until completely cooked through.
Slice the tomato and prepare the lettuce.
Lightly toast the sandwich bread.
Spread mayonnaise on the inside of the bread.
Add lettuce, tomato, cooked chicken, and cheese.
Close the sandwich and serve.
tips: Slice the chicken evenly so it cooks at the same rate.
You can lightly toast the bread for extra texture.

name: Omelette
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl.
Beat the eggs with salt and black pepper.
Chop the onion, tomato, and bell pepper into small pieces.
Melt the butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and bell pepper and cook briefly.
Add the tomato and cook for another minute.
Pour the beaten eggs over the vegetables.
Let the eggs cook until the edges begin to set.
Add the cheese.
Fold the omelette in half.
Continue cooking until the eggs are fully set.
Serve immediately.
tips: Keep the heat moderate so the eggs cook gently.
Do not overload the omelette with fillings.

name: Beef Pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a large pan.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add the garlic and cook briefly.
Add the ground beef and cook until browned and completely cooked.
Add the chopped tomatoes.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Simmer the sauce until the tomatoes soften and the mixture thickens.
Drain the pasta and add it to the beef sauce.
Mix until the pasta is evenly coated.
Top with cheese and serve hot.
tips: Reserve some pasta water to loosen the sauce if needed.
Break the beef into small pieces while cooking.

name: Chicken Soup
steps: Cut the chicken into small pieces.
Peel and chop the potatoes and carrots.
Chop the onion and garlic.
Place the chicken and water in a large pot.
Bring the water to a gentle boil.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and potatoes.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Reduce the heat and simmer until the chicken and vegetables are completely cooked.
Check that the chicken reaches a safe internal temperature of 74°C.
Add the chopped parsley near the end of cooking.
Taste and adjust the seasoning.
Serve hot.
tips: Remove any foam that rises to the surface during the early cooking stage.
Cut the vegetables into similar-sized pieces so they cook evenly.

name: Garlic Bread
steps: Preheat the oven to 200°C.
Melt the butter in a small bowl.
Add minced garlic and chopped parsley to the butter.
Cut the bread into slices without cutting all the way through the bottom.
Spread the garlic butter between the slices.
Add grated cheese over the bread.
Place the bread on a baking tray.
Bake until the bread is crisp and the cheese has melted.
Remove from the oven and serve warm.
tips: Do not cut completely through the loaf if you want the slices to stay connected.
Watch the bread during the final minutes because it can brown quickly.

name: Vegetable Rice
steps: Rinse the rice until the water becomes mostly clear.
Heat olive oil in a pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened.
Add garlic, carrot, peas, corn, and bell pepper.
Cook the vegetables for several minutes.
Add the rinsed rice and stir for one minute.
Add enough water according to the rice package instructions.
Season with salt.
Bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat, cover the pot, and cook until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed.
Turn off the heat and let the rice rest covered for a few minutes.
Fluff the rice gently with a fork and serve.
tips: Avoid stirring the rice repeatedly while it cooks.
Letting the rice rest after cooking helps improve its texture.

name: Chicken Wrap
steps: Cut the chicken into thin strips.
Season the chicken with salt and black pepper.
Heat a pan over medium heat.
Cook the chicken until completely cooked through.
Mix yogurt with minced garlic to make a simple sauce.
Slice the tomato and prepare the lettuce.
Warm the flatbreads briefly.
Spread the yogurt sauce over each flatbread.
Add lettuce, tomato, chicken, and cheese.
Fold the sides of the flatbread inward and roll it tightly.
Serve immediately.
tips: Do not overfill the wrap because it can become difficult to roll.
Warm the bread slightly before rolling.

name: Potato Omelette
steps: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small thin pieces.
Slice the onion.
Heat olive oil in a non-stick pan.
Add the potatoes and cook until they begin to soften.
Add the onion and continue cooking until the potatoes are tender and lightly golden.
Beat the eggs in a bowl with salt and black pepper.
Pour the eggs over the potato and onion mixture.
Cook over medium-low heat until the bottom is set.
Carefully turn or fold the omelette.
Continue cooking until the eggs are fully set.
Serve warm.
tips: Cut the potatoes evenly so they cook at the same rate.
Use medium-low heat once the eggs are added.

name: Creamy Chicken Pasta
steps: Cut the chicken into small pieces.
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water according to the package instructions.
Melt the butter in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until completely cooked through.
Add the minced garlic and cook briefly until fragrant.
Add the milk and cream.
Stir gently and allow the sauce to warm without boiling aggressively.
Add the cheese and stir until melted and creamy.
Season with salt and black pepper.
Add the cooked pasta to the sauce.
Mix until the chicken, pasta, and sauce are evenly combined.
Serve hot.
tips: Reserve some pasta water to adjust the sauce consistency.
Keep the heat moderate after adding the dairy ingredients.
Make sure the chicken is completely cooked before serving.
